svg.title: Capability dependency graph
svg.desc: Static snapshot of CapabilityKit's bubble dependency graph. Arrows point from dependencies to dependents; colors reflect saved acceptance coverage, not detection accuracy.

g.text: Bubble dependency map. Open the interactive map to explore paths and evidence.
